copy.curiosityHook: Assigned to head a high-stakes homicide probe, an investigator discovers that the clues he uncovers are steadily assembling a case against himself.
copy.description: After a passionate liaison with a woman who is also seeing the Secretary of Defense, Navy Lt. Tom Farrell is assigned to lead her murder inquiry, only to find the evidence pointing straight back to him.
copy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and tightly wound, this steady 1987 thriller delivers moderate emotional weight and high-pressure investigative tension.
copy.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson crafts a sharp, suspenseful political thriller where a military investigator must solve a homicide while actively dodging his own growing entrapment.

allowedMaterial: Tom Farrell's relationship with Susan Atwell
Susan's simultaneous involvement with Defense Secretary David Brice
Susan's murder and Farrell leading the investigation
Farrell becoming a suspect as his connection comes to light
excludedMaterial: Cold War spy or mole plot twists
Deep cover or Soviet operative revelations
